request.initial_prompt: [Enter a King and a Queen very lovingly; the Queen embracing him and he her. She kneels, and makes show of protestation unto him. He takes her up, and declines his head upon her neck. Lays him down upon a bank of flowers. She, seeing him asleep, leaves him. Anon comes in a fellow, takes off his crown, kisses it, pours poison in the King's ears, and exits. The Queen returns, finds the King dead, and makes passionate action. The Poisoner with some three or four Mutes, comes in again, seeming to lament with her. The dead body is carried away. The Poisoner woos the Queen with gifts. She seems loth and unwilling awhile, but in the end accepts his love]

raw_segments.text: Enter a King and a Queen very lovingly, the Queen embracing him and he her. She kneels and
makes show of protestation unto him. He takes her up, and declines his head upon her neck.
Lays him down upon a bank of flowers. She, seeing him asleep, leaves him. Anon comes
in a fellow, takes off his crown, kisses it, pours poison in the King's ears, and exits.
The Queen returns, finds the King dead, and makes passionate action. The Poisoner with
some three or four Mutes, comes in again, seeming to lament with her. The dead body
is carried away. The Poisoner woos the Queen with gifts. She seems loth and unwilling
awhile, but in the end accepts his love.
